title: Voltox × wallee Terminal & Unattended Integration Self-Assessment
basis: wallee ep2 Integration Self-Assessment V1.0 (18.09.2026, M. Bitzer), extended with Voltox gates (VX), surrogate PAN (SUR) and device security (SEC).
characteristics: Voltox products used (Age Verification, Smile & Pay, Face Recognition, KYC)

requirements.title: Printer
requirements.text: A printer is available (min. 24 characters per line, cutter). Optional for unattended devices without printer.
requirements.guidance: Devices without printer (e.g. IM30): electronic receipt / QR receipt.

requirements.title: Buzzer
requirements.text: A buzzer is present and clearly audible.
requirements.guidance: Terminal-internal buzzer or audio of the vending machine.

requirements.title: Communication
requirements.text: A communication channel is available (LAN, WLAN or mobile).
requirements.guidance: For 4G operation: sufficient data volume; software updates preferably via LAN/WLAN.

requirements.title: Use case
requirements.text: Activate terminal (manual and automatic).

requirements.title: Use case
requirements.text: Deactivate terminal (manual and automatic).

requirements.title: Use case
requirements.text: Terminal status request (manual).

requirements.title: Use case
requirements.text: Trigger transmission / submission (manual and automatic).

requirements.title: Use case
requirements.text: Trigger configuration update (manual and automatic).

requirements.title: Use case
requirements.text: Final balance / day-end closing (manual and automatic).

requirements.title: Use case
requirements.text: Purchase of a single product.

requirements.title: Use case
requirements.text: Purchase of a single product of CHF 1'080.00. The apostrophe as thousands separator is handled correctly by the ECR.

requirements.title: Brand signalisation
requirements.text: All accepted card brands are shown on the vending machine or terminal display (dynamic) or by stickers on the machine (static).

requirements.title: Security
requirements.text: Remote maintenance of the ECR / VM has no remote access to the terminal.

requirements.title: Product delivery
requirements.text: Product delivery is monitored (double commit): the final amount is only booked after confirmed delivery.
requirements.guidance: Reservation → delivery → completion with effective amount; on failure cancel / reversal.

requirements.title: Product delivery
requirements.text: Product is delivered only after the card has been removed.

requirements.title: Cardholder support
requirements.text: Cardholder information to reach the operator's support is visible (phone number, intercom, etc.).

requirements.title: Monitoring
requirements.text: Vending machine system monitoring is available (periodic poll or push, e.g. status request).

requirements.title: PIN privacy
requirements.text: Privacy during PIN entry according to the PCI PTS security policy of the terminal is fulfilled.

requirements.title: Power failure
requirements.text: No transactions are lost.

requirements.title: Power failure
requirements.text: The event log is stored permanently.

requirements.title: Power failure
requirements.text: After a power failure without product delivery, the VM reverses incomplete transactions.

requirements.title: Power failure
requirements.text: After a power failure with product delivery, the effective amount is transmitted / submitted.

requirements.title: Power failure
requirements.text: All data needed for the automatic restart after a power failure is stored permanently.

requirements.title: Power failure
requirements.text: The power failure is shown to the cardholder.

requirements.title: Accessibility
requirements.text: Tactile marks on the keys 'O', 'X', '|' and bump on '5'.
requirements.guidance: Not applicable for PIN-on-glass devices (e.g. IM30): mark n/a.

requirements.title: Transaction abort
requirements.text: The transaction can be aborted by pressing 'Stop' or by timeout.

requirements.title: Vend failure
requirements.text: On vend failure, no credit is converted: cash credit is escrowed, card credit is refunded. Card credit is never converted to cash.

requirements.title: Customer receipt
requirements.text: Customer receipt can be logged or printed.

requirements.title: Merchant receipt
requirements.text: Merchant receipt can be logged or printed.

requirements.title: ep2 receipts
requirements.text: All receipts comply with the ep2 specification in layout and content.

requirements.title: Receipt reprint
requirements.text: The ECR front end offers a function to actively trigger a receipt reprint on the terminal.
requirements.guidance: Check availability for the chosen interface; if not available, request a waiver.

requirements.title: Transaction recovery
requirements.text: After a communication loss the ECR recovers the status of the last transaction automatically: completed transactions are booked, incomplete ones are reversed.

requirements.title: Deferred / offline
requirements.text: Deferred (offline) authorisation is disabled, unless approved in writing by wallee.
requirements.guidance: If enabled, declined deferred transactions are a loss for the merchant.

requirements.title: Network security
requirements.text: The terminal is operated in a protected network segment. No inbound access from the internet to the terminal or the local till interface port.

requirements.title: Timeouts
requirements.text: The payment timeout of the ECR / VM is longer than the maximum transaction time of the terminal (card read, PIN entry, host response).
requirements.guidance: Otherwise a late approval can arrive after the ECR has given up (payment without product).

requirements.title: Unique reference
requirements.text: Each payment request carries a unique ECR reference. Duplicate requests are detected and not charged twice.

requirements.title: Reconciliation
requirements.text: The ECR transaction journal can be reconciled with the wallee Portal and the day-end totals (count, amount, reference).

requirements.title: Auto recovery
requirements.text: After a terminal reboot or software update (e.g. nightly), terminal and ECR return to the ready state automatically, without manual intervention.

requirements.title: Software updates
requirements.text: Terminal software updates run in an agreed maintenance window and never interrupt a running transaction.

requirements.title: Card brands
requirements.text: All contractually agreed card brands and payment methods are initialised and tested (incl. contactless kernels).

requirements.title: Operator manual
requirements.text: The operator manual covers error handling, restart procedure and support contacts.

requirements.title: Fail-closed gates
requirements.text: Every Voltox result is evaluated fail-closed: only RESULT_OK with isVerified == true (Age Verification) or onPaid (Smile & Pay) continues; cancelled, missing, malformed or late results deny.

requirements.title: Gate order
requirements.text: No product is released and no purchase is completed before all required gates passed (age → payment → delivery). Parallel reservations are cancelled immediately on denial or timeout.

requirements.title: Product separation
requirements.text: Results of one Voltox product are never used as the result of another (face match ≠ age verification ≠ KYC).

requirements.title: Credentials
requirements.text: Voltox Client Secret and any wallee keys are stored in secure configuration, never in source code, logs, crash reports or screenshots; rotation procedure documented.

requirements.title: Production configuration
requirements.text: Developer mode is disabled (developerModeEnabled / developerMode = false); production Client ID; theme and display mode published and tested.

requirements.title: Biometric data
requirements.text: No face or document images, dates of birth or document numbers are stored or logged by the integration; consent texts for biometric processing are shown where required.

requirements.title: Age threshold per product
requirements.text: requiredAge is set per product category before every flow; boundary values (face ≥ age+5, document ≥ age) are tested for each threshold used.

requirements.title: Document fallback
requirements.text: A document fallback is available that works on the target hardware (Android NFC, visual ID or phone hand-off); external non-Android NFC readers are not relied on.

requirements.title: QR hand-off
requirements.text: The originating device stays online during phone verification; 'Completed' on the phone is never treated as approval.

requirements.title: Smile & Pay amounts
requirements.text: Amounts in minor units, minimum 5.00, currency fixed per merchant; basket change starts a new session; receipt uses onPaid amount and currency.

requirements.title: Exactly-once fulfilment
requirements.text: Orders are fulfilled exactly once per payment reference (paymentIntentId / appPaymentId / wallee transaction id).

requirements.title: Stored credential on wallee
requirements.text: If payments run on wallee: credential established card-present with cardholder verification (ep2 BUC 40, Transaction Reason Code 2), consent stored, subsequent charges flagged as cardholder-initiated stored-credential payments as agreed with wallee.

requirements.title: Performance budget
requirements.text: Measured p95 on target hardware and network: SDK screen ≤ 500 ms, face→age decision ≤ 3 s, face→onPaid ≤ 5 s, card tap→payment result ≤ 3 s (online CTLS without PIN), ready after boot ≤ 30 s.

requirements.title: Surrogate PAN offered
requirements.text: The integration requests surrogate PAN values (LTI panHashVariants / PanHash or equivalent) where card recognition is part of the use case, using ep2-hmac variants on ep2 v8 terminals; generatePanToken is not used in new code.

requirements.title: Surrogate domain
requirements.text: The surrogate domain (key set and DOL) is agreed with wallee and documented; behaviour on card replacement is defined.

requirements.title: Surrogate is not a credential
requirements.text: The surrogate PAN is never used to charge, refund or reverse; it is stored separately from biometric data with purpose, retention and deletion defined.

requirements.title: Device integrity
requirements.text: Release builds only (no debug), obfuscated, signed; root/emulator detection where payments or biometrics run; wallee Paydroid remains home app on terminals.

requirements.title: Transport security
requirements.text: All backend calls use TLS with certificate validation; LTI only inside the protected LAN segment.

requirements.title: Physical security
requirements.text: Machine and terminal mounting prevents tampering; camera position and privacy shield do not conflict (PIN privacy and face capture).

tests.title: Stop by cardholder
tests.steps: Press STOP on the terminal.
tests.expected: Message "Stopped by cardholder" (or similar) is displayed. Transaction declined, no receipt printed.

tests.title: Communication problem VM – terminal
tests.pre: Terminal activated, VM has no connection to the terminal
tests.steps: Choose product. Pay with card.
tests.expected: Error message on the VM. Card payment not possible. Note further details.

tests.title: Communication problem terminal – acquirer
tests.pre: Terminal activated, connection to the acquirer lost
tests.steps: Choose product. Pay with card. Unplug terminal communication during card read (before PIN confirmation). Check display, timeout and logs.
tests.expected: Transaction aborted or declined. No product delivery. Auto-reversal expected.

tests.title: No communication terminal – acquirer
tests.pre: Terminal activated, connection to the acquirer lost
tests.steps: Choose product above floor limit. Pay with card. Unplug network before PIN entry.
tests.expected: Transaction aborted. Check error message on the terminal. No product delivery.

tests.title: Power off terminal (PIN entry)
tests.steps: Choose product. Pay with card (amount sent). Power off terminal at PIN entry. After VM timeout, restart terminal.
tests.expected: VM reaches timeout and shows an error message. No product delivery. After reboot the terminal is activated (no reversal needed).

tests.title: Power off terminal (processing)
tests.pre: Terminal activated. Note last transaction sequence no.
tests.steps: Choose product under floor limit. Pay with card (amount sent). Power off terminal after PIN entry ("Processing" on display). After VM timeout, restart terminal. Pay CHF 10.00 with another card.
tests.expected: VM reaches timeout and shows an error message. No product delivery. After reboot the terminal is activated and performs an auto-reversal.

tests.title: Power off VM
tests.steps: Choose product. Pay with card (amount sent). Power off VM after PIN entry and approval (no commit VM – terminal possible). After terminal timeout, restart VM.
tests.expected: Terminal reaches timeout and shows an error message. Auto-reversal performed by the terminal. No product delivery. After reboot the VM returns to its initial state.

tests.title: Activation after reboot
tests.steps: Turn on / reboot.
tests.expected: Activation is done automatically after boot, or the VM application activates the terminal before the next transaction.

tests.title: Shutdown
tests.steps: Turn off or reboot the VM. Check submission / transmission behaviour.
tests.expected: All transactions are submitted before shutdown, either technically (submission after each transaction) or by process (shutdown checklist for the operator).

tests.title: Process transaction – chip
tests.steps: Single product, contact chip transaction (ICC).
tests.expected: Transaction approved. Product released.

tests.title: Process transaction – contactless below CVM limit
tests.steps: Single product, contactless transaction below CVM limit.
tests.expected: Transaction approved. Product released.

tests.title: Process transaction – magstripe
tests.steps: Single product, magstripe transaction.
tests.expected: Transaction approved. Product released.

tests.title: Process transaction – contactless above CVM limit
tests.steps: Single product, contactless transaction above CVM limit.
tests.expected: Transaction approved (with PIN or CDCVM). Product released.
tests.guidance: CTLS-only devices without PIN: see T-052.

tests.title: Logs
tests.steps: Check available logs. Check where merchant transaction receipts are logged.
tests.expected: Available logs are documented (transaction log). Logs verified.

tests.title: Brand signalisation
tests.steps: Check brand signalisation and take a photo.
tests.expected: All accepted card brands are shown on the VM or terminal display (dynamic) or by stickers on the VM (static).

tests.title: Card removed before timeout
tests.steps: Choose product. Pay with card. Remove card after the prompt, before the terminal timeout.
tests.expected: Terminal prompts to remove the card (acoustic and visual). Vend approved; product delivered only after card removal.

tests.title: Card left until timeout
tests.steps: Choose product. Pay with card. Do not remove the card until the terminal timeout has elapsed.
tests.expected: Terminal prompts repeatedly to remove the card. No product delivery (vend denied). Transaction aborted or auto-reversed (alternatively "vend cancel" from the VMC).

tests.title: Product not available
tests.steps: Choose product (if possible). Pay with card.
tests.expected: Error message on the VM. Card payment not possible. Note further details.

tests.title: VM delivery error
tests.pre: Terminal activated, VM ok. Delivery not ready or product missing
tests.steps: Choose product (selection possible). Pay with card. Product cannot be delivered.
tests.expected: Terminal approval (vend approved). No product delivery. Error message on the VM. VMC sends "vend failure". Terminal performs auto-reversal.

tests.title: Privacy during PIN entry
tests.pre: Privacy shield installed or cardholder can cover the PIN entry (per terminal PCI PTS security policy)
tests.steps: Take a photo. Check viewing angles according to PCI.
tests.expected: PIN privacy is ensured according to the PCI PTS security policy of the terminal.

tests.title: No payment
tests.steps: Choose product. Do NOT pay – wait until the timeout is reached.
tests.expected: Notification and/or beep on VM or terminal. Product not released. VM returns to initial state or offers another payment method.

tests.title: Payment status after ECR loss
tests.pre: Transaction completed, result could not be sent to the ECR
tests.steps: Send the amount to the terminal, then kill the ECR application or cut the ECR connection. Card payment is processed on the terminal. Reconnect the ECR.
tests.expected: After reconnection the ECR automatically determines the status of the last transaction and synchronises with the terminal (book or reverse), without manual intervention.

tests.title: Declined transaction
tests.pre: Test card that is declined by the issuer
tests.steps: Choose product. Pay with declined card.
tests.expected: Clear decline message on terminal and VM. No product delivery. VM returns to initial state.

tests.title: Wrong PIN
tests.steps: Enter a wrong PIN, then the correct PIN. Repeat until PIN try limit is reached (test card).
tests.expected: Wrong PIN message; correct PIN leads to approval. PIN try limit: transaction declined, no product.
tests.guidance: Only for devices with PIN entry.

tests.title: Contactless above CVM limit without PIN pad
tests.steps: Pay amount above CVM limit with a physical card.
tests.expected: Transaction declined or cardholder guided to another payment method. No product delivery, clear message.

tests.title: Mobile wallet
tests.steps: Pay below and above CVM limit with Apple Pay / Google Pay.
tests.expected: Both transactions approved (CDCVM on phone). Product released.

tests.title: Soft decline (PIN required)
tests.pre: Test card producing a soft decline on contactless
tests.steps: Pay contactless with the test card.
tests.expected: Terminal asks to insert the card and enter the PIN, or declines with a clear message. No product without approval.

tests.title: Card brand matrix
tests.steps: One approved transaction per initialised brand / payment method (e.g. Visa, Mastercard, Maestro, PostFinance, TWINT, Amex, others as contracted).
tests.expected: All transactions approved. Brand displayed correctly on receipt and in the wallee Portal.

tests.title: TWINT / QR payment
tests.steps: Pay with TWINT. Repeat: cancel in the app. Repeat: let the QR code time out.
tests.expected: Success, cancel and timeout are reported correctly to the ECR / VM. Product only released on success.

tests.title: Reversal of last transaction
tests.steps: Trigger reversal of the last transaction from the ECR.
tests.expected: Transaction reversed, receipt printed / logged. Reversal visible in the wallee Portal.

tests.title: Refund / credit
tests.steps: Trigger a refund from the ECR.
tests.expected: Refund processed, receipt printed / logged. Refund visible in the wallee Portal.

tests.title: Reservation with lower final amount
tests.steps: Reserve amount (e.g. CHF 50.00). Deliver partially (e.g. CHF 12.40). Complete with effective amount.
tests.expected: Only the effective amount is charged. Completion above the reserved amount is rejected.

tests.title: Reservation without delivery
tests.steps: Reserve amount. No delivery (cancel or timeout).
tests.expected: Reservation is cancelled / released. No charge.

tests.title: Duplicate request
tests.steps: Send the same payment request twice (same ECR reference), e.g. by double click or retry.
tests.expected: Only one transaction is processed and charged.

tests.title: Late approval near ECR timeout
tests.steps: Delay the transaction until close to the ECR timeout (e.g. slow PIN entry). Approve the transaction.
tests.expected: ECR and terminal show the same status. No product without payment, no payment without product (reversal if needed).

tests.title: Network recovery
tests.steps: Disconnect the terminal network for approx. 5 minutes, then reconnect. Start a transaction.
tests.expected: Terminal goes back online automatically, without reboot. Next transaction approved.

tests.title: Scheduled reboot
tests.steps: Trigger the scheduled (e.g. nightly) terminal reboot. Start a transaction afterwards.
tests.expected: Terminal and ECR ready without manual intervention. Payment application in the foreground. First transaction approved.

tests.title: Terminal software update
tests.steps: Install the terminal software update via TMS. Start a transaction afterwards.
tests.expected: Terminal ready without manual intervention. Configuration and keys intact. Transaction approved.

tests.title: Day-end around midnight
tests.steps: Run transactions shortly before and after the day-end time.
tests.expected: All transactions submitted. Each transaction in the correct settlement period.

tests.title: Reconciliation
tests.steps: Compare ECR journal, wallee Portal and day-end totals.
tests.expected: Count, amounts and references match.

tests.title: Amount edge cases
tests.steps: Pay the smallest amount (CHF 0.05). Try amount CHF 0.00. Pay a high amount (e.g. CHF 9'999.95).
tests.expected: Small and high amounts processed correctly. Amount 0.00 does not start a payment.

tests.title: MDB cashless session
tests.steps: Vend request → vend approved → vend success. Vend failure. Session cancel by the VMC. Reader disable / enable by the VMC.
tests.expected: Success: amount charged, product delivered. Failure and cancel: no charge (reversal). Disabled reader accepts no card.

tests.title: MDB – VMC reset during session
tests.steps: Reset / power-cycle the VMC during an active session.
tests.expected: No charge without product delivery. Reader returns to idle state.

tests.title: Cardholder guidance
tests.steps: Check all states: idle, present card, processing, approved, declined, error.
tests.expected: Messages on the VM match the terminal state and are understandable in the configured languages.

tests.title: Concurrent access
tests.steps: Send a second request while a transaction is running.
tests.expected: Second request rejected cleanly. Running transaction not affected.

tests.title: Age gate denial paths
tests.steps: Cancel on every screen; system back on first screen; let face-scan window expire; kill the app during the flow; airplane mode during upload.
tests.expected: Every path denies; no payment started or reservation cancelled; no product released.

tests.title: Age boundaries
tests.steps: For each threshold used: face estimate age+4 and age+5; document exactly age and age minus one day.
tests.expected: age+4 → document step; age+5 → pass; document = age → pass; age − 1 day → deny.

tests.title: Spoof attempts
tests.steps: Printed photo, screen replay, video, mask (as available).
tests.expected: Denied (spoof/evasion); never routed to registration; never charged.

tests.title: Smile & Pay exactly once
tests.steps: Double tap Pay; kill host app right after charge and restart; network loss during charge.
tests.expected: One charge per session; order fulfilled once; interrupted cases reconciled before retry.

tests.title: Smile & Pay amount rules
tests.steps: Amount 4.99; 5.00; change basket after start.
tests.expected: 4.99 rejected; 5.00 accepted; basket change starts a new session.

tests.title: Performance measurement
tests.steps: Run ≥ 50 flows per path; record step timings.
tests.expected: p95 within the performance budget (VX-PERF-01).

tests.title: Surrogate PAN stability
tests.steps: Same card: chip, contactless, wallet token on phone; two terminals of the same domain; one terminal of another domain; replacement card.
tests.expected: Behaviour matches the documented domain and DOL (same/different values as designed); unknown value triggers the re-verification flow.

tests.title: Surrogate PAN with payment
tests.steps: Request panHashVariants on a purchase; stand-alone PanHash without payment.
tests.expected: Values returned in both cases; no extra tap needed for the payment case; no PAN in any log.
